title: Genestealer Cults — Industrial Nocturne

design_goal.table_readability: High contrast and bright enough to read at gaming distance without losing a grimdark finish.
design_goal.army_cohesion: Cold dark armour versus warm dirty cloth, with pale magenta-violet biology and restrained industrial orange accents.
design_goal.vehicle_inheritance: Existing vehicles are dirty dark yellow with brown/rust streaking. Infantry repeats this warm industrial family in restrained orange/ochre/rust accents rather than copying the vehicle colour as a dominant mass.

armour_and_protective_plates.hue: very dark navy / Dark Prussian Blue family
armour_and_protective_plates.notes: Human protective armour stays clearly colder and darker than cloth and flesh.

cloth_and_robes.hue: dirty red-orange / rust-red / brick / burnt orange
cloth_and_robes.value: one step lighter than navy armour
cloth_and_robes.notes: No graphite-grey cloth as a major mass. Warm fabric is the main silhouette separator from navy armour.

industrial_orange_accents.hue: dirty ochre through burnt orange to selective bright orange
industrial_orange_accents.notes: Bright orange remains an accent, not a second full-body mass.

flesh.hue: pale flesh / bone-beige with magenta-violet shadows and veins

mutation_gradient.Neophyte: mostly pale human-adjacent skin with restrained purple-magenta around eyes, joints and veins
mutation_gradient.Acolyte: stronger magenta-violet shadows and more visible alien vascular colour
mutation_gradient.Aberrant: large pale-bone musculature with strong purple-magenta recesses and mutations
mutation_gradient.Purestrain: fully alien expression of the same bloodline: pale magenta-violet flesh plus dark navy xeno plates

xeno_plates_and_growths.finish: slightly more satin/organic than human armour
xeno_plates_and_growths.notes: Should read as related to the army navy while remaining visibly organic.

red.notes: Used only on small ritual/cult details so it does not compete with magenta flesh or rusty cloth.

metals.weathering: brown rust, soot, grime, selective fresh metallic edges

colour_theory.primary_contrast: Cold navy versus warm rusty red-orange creates a strong complementary/near-complementary temperature contrast.
colour_theory.biological_bridge: Magenta sits between red and violet and visually links warm rusty cloth to cold blue-violet xeno biology.
colour_theory.tabletop_rule: Brightness comes from value and temperature separation, not from making every surface saturated.

oil_role_map.Серая Пейна: cold armour/xeno recesses and cool structural shadows
oil_role_map.Умбра жжёная: rust, dirt, lower cloth, warm industrial grime
oil_role_map.Масляная магента: flesh, veins, mutation zones and organic transitions

sequence: tiny White point at the tip
horns.oil: Burnt Umber near the root after protective varnish
horns.three_horns_note: For a three-horn model, keep the same family but vary the amount of dark root/light tip slightly between horns so they do not look mechanically identical.

production_direction.preferred_method: airbrush zenithal/grisaille + transparent colour mapping + selective opaque highlights + oils
production_direction.reason: Designed for army-scale production and to exploit the user's airbrush instead of brush-basecoating large navy areas repeatedly.
production_direction.navy_candidate: Leviadon Blue over a controlled light-value underpainting where practical; airbrush can be used as a transparent filter on models with large navy/xeno areas.
production_direction.skin_candidate: Airbrush pale sickly flesh modulation on Acolytes, Aberrants and Purestrains where flesh dominates.
production_direction.finish: final matte overall, selective satin/gloss returned to xeno plates, eyes, tongue and wet organic details

lore_positioning.secondary_visual_inheritance: classic Genestealer blue-violet / pale alien biology
lore_positioning.interpretation: An industrial/mining-world descendant cult: worn work gear, rusted machinery and hazard colours, with increasingly visible xeno genetics from Neophytes through Purestrains.
lore_positioning.note: This is not intended to reproduce an official cult paint scheme exactly.

supersedes_in_this_chat: graphite-grey cloth as a major colour mass
bright orange as a broad clothing colour
